cards.name: Echo of Inspiration
cards.target: One original target of one eligible source
cards.effect: Create one pending Echo package using the immediate, unmodified damage OR healing dice of one eligible performance you resolved this turn or on your previous turn. At the start of your next turn, repeat 50% of that stored dice total, rounded down, to one of its original affected targets still within 30 feet. A positive fraction has minimum 1. cards.name: Symphony of Mastery
cards.effect: For up to 3 Bard turns while sustained, your first qualifying, non-consuming performance started AFTER this Symphony on your own turn gains 2 Crescendo instead of 1. Starting the Symphony itself follows the ordinary one-stack rule. Total Crescendo gain remains capped at 2 per Bard turn, even with Masterful Verse. Once during the duration, you may start one non-Finale performance that normally takes an Action as a Bonus Action, paying its full RP and recharge costs. Using that Bonus Action leaves none to maintain this Symphony that turn; if it is a later turn before maintenance, the Symphony remains active through that performance (including its accelerated gain), then immediately ends. Starting another concentration effect still ends the Symphony immediately, before the new effect resolves. It never grants an extra Action.
cards.crescendoRider: Reduce one OTHER performance's positive round-recharge counter by 1, subject to the single reset/shortening cap. Per-rest uses remain spent.
